name: airmed-hbys
description: Hospital Information System for ophthalmology clinics — NestJS, Prisma, tRPC, React, Vite

scripts.test: npm run pkg:build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run pkg:build && npm run test --workspace=@airmed/contracts && npm run test --workspace=@airmed/observability && npm run test:unit --workspace=@airmed/api && npm run test --workspace=@airmed/web && npm run test --workspace=@airmed/admin
scripts.test:coverage: npm run pkg:build && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run pkg:build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.pkg:build: npm run build --workspace=@airmed/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@airmed/db && npm run build --workspace=@airmed/observability
